findings.summary: Dead code: _log_feedback_error (lines 588-596) and _log_max_retries_exceeded (lines 598-606) are never called after _get_llm_feedback_response was removed; import of MAX_LLM_RETRY at line 20 is now only used in these dead methods
findings.failure_scenario: Developers reading this code will be misled into thinking these methods are part of active error-handling paths; they consume the MAX_LLM_RETRY constant import and add maintenance burden with no benefit

findings.summary: Stale @pytest.mark.vcr decorator on test_agent_human_input references a deleted cassette file (tests/cassettes/test_agent_human_input.yaml) and is unnecessary since _invoke_loop is now mocked
findings.failure_scenario: The VCR marker is misleading -- it suggests the test uses cassette replay when it actually patches _invoke_loop to avoid all HTTP calls. The decorator serves no purpose and will confuse future maintainers

findings.summary: Test coverage regression: _invoke_loop is patched with a fixed return_value=AgentFinish(output='Hello'), so the test cannot verify that _process_feedback_iteration properly appends feedback to messages or that the LLM processes feedback correctly
findings.failure_scenario: If _process_feedback_iteration had a bug (e.g., it fails to append the feedback instructions to self.messages before calling _invoke_loop), the test would still pass because the mock always returns 'Hello' regardless of the actual message state. The deleted cassette test previously verified real LLM feedback processing behavior
